title: Dump-and-Go White Chicken Chili | 44g Protein
description: Everything goes into the crockpot in the morning. Shred and stir at night, then top this creamy white chicken chili with tortilla strips, Greek yogurt, and jalapeño.
image_prompt: A realistic bowl containing exactly 12 ounces of thick creamy white chicken chili with visible shredded chicken, cannellini beans, golden corn, and mild green chiles. Top with a small dollop equal to 2 tablespoons of plain Greek yogurt, 2 tablespoons of crunchy tortilla strips, and 2 to 3 thin fresh jalapeño slices. Natural window light and cozy family-dinner presentation. No shredded cheese, avocado, cilantro, lime, onions, extra tortilla chips, or unlisted garnishes.
image_alt_text: Creamy white chicken chili topped with tortilla strips, Greek yogurt, and thin jalapeño slices.
